required_effects.reason: All four evaluated callback groups, including empty groups, in restore-lisp-pointers traversal order. Bind callback objects directly, not their printed variable labels.
All paired compile-time effects in r7. Completion events witness execution; semantic prerequisite edges still need qualification.
Keep every emitted load effect, including effects not executed by the compiling host. Emission is not execution.

scope_limits: This revised proposal awaits independent review; the prior review with findings is not approval of revision 2.

The finite candidate universe retains all r7 compiler bodies and all resident clean-image code prototypes, including inspector code. It is not a proved bound on arbitrary future EVAL, FASL loading, rebinding, plugins, or all stub-backend paths.
No bootstrap implementation is repaired by scanning the heap or rebinding names; this is observation only.
S0-LL08-a static reachability and operator/lowering/effect qualification remain prerequisites to the complete census.
Seed revision alone does not repair unconditional image/source membership widening. No old closure result is valid evidence for this revision.
Callback-vector inspection after restore is recorded as such. Equality with image-save contents and bounds on later callback registration are not inferred.
review_basis: doc/WASM/stage0/seed-review.md at a1df24e7; revised proposal requires a new independent review

cold_start_strategy.reason: Name the whole reviewed source chain and applicable methods. This does not pretend to read the already-executed saved closure after startup.

method_seeds.reason: Retain every applicable method conservatively, including a less-specific primary even if standard method combination does not call it.

required_bindings.name: CCL::%PASCAL-FUNCTIONS%
required_bindings.scope: saved-image members and post-restore members; complete slot inventory including empty slots
required_bindings.reason: Dispatch can reach every live slot. Snapshot inspection is not a bound on future callback registration; save/restore equality and later registration remain obligations.

required_bindings.name: CCL::%BUILTIN-FUNCTIONS%
required_bindings.scope: all 23 U1 slots in xdump/xfasload.lisp, resolved through their current function cells
required_bindings.reason: Seed every native slow-path target by slot, independently of source-module membership. This is the native census, not a Wasm implementation assertion.

exclusions.name: CCL::%FOREIGN-THREAD-CONTROL
exclusions.scope: independent root only, for the selected no-init startup plus native rebuild workload
exclusions.reason: The selected workload does not request entry from a foreign-created thread. Batch mode alone does not prohibit such entry. Retain the callback slot and all ordinary references; any workload that admits foreign-created threads must add this entry as a root.
